stimulus.source_note: Original summary; Verrazano 1524, Cartier 1534-1542, Cabot 1497, Quebec 1608, Jamestown 1607.
stimulus.text: Roanoke's colonists vanished in the late 1580s; nearly twenty years passed before England planted another colony at Jamestown.

stem: France sent Verrazano along the Atlantic coast in 1524 and Cartier up the St. Lawrence in the 1530s, yet France planted no lasting colony in North America until Quebec in 1608. England sent Cabot in 1497, yet planted no lasting colony until Jamestown in 1607. Which pattern do these two cases share?

options.text: Both countries chose to build their empires in Asia instead of the Americas
Both countries explored early but settled late, leaving the first century of colonization to Spain
Both countries ignored North America entirely until they settled there in the 1600s
Both countries were forbidden by the Treaty of Tordesillas from settling in North America

instruction: Pick one option from the stimulus and stem only. Do not open the question file.
